contexts.text: These more subtle evil Spirits... are like fools.
Like an ignis fatuus. AC 4419:2.
The other comes from foolish lumen.
The case with foolish lumen there. Explained.
Such is the case with those who are in foolish lumen...
The things in the centre are in... a fatuous lumen, like that from a charcoal fire.
He who sees only from the world, sees from a foolish lumen.
When in Heaven (these Spirits) became like fools.
Some of those (who had crammed the memory only) were stupid, some were fools...
They who are corporeal loves are stupid and as it were fools.
They who have lived in evil... and have consequently denied the Divine... in the other life appear... like fools. Described.
They who ascribe all things to their Own intelligence... at first become like drunkards, afterwards like fools, and at last stupid. TCR 276:end.
From this may be seen the folly of those who ascribe all things to nature.
Every man, unless born silly, or excessively stupid, can attain to reason and freedom themselves.
Freedom and rationality themselves cannot exist with those who are fools from birth; nor to those who have become fools afterwards, so long as they remain fools.

The difference is as that between fatuous light and genuine light; and, in the Spiritual World, fatuous light is of such a nature, that when genuine light flows in, it is turned into darkness; such fatuous light exists with many in Hell...
They were told that they see it in fatuous light. They asked what fatuous light is; and were informed that fatuous light is the light of the continuation of falsity... AR 566:3.
If they are whoremongers, they are cast out into the fatuous lights of the south, (which are) falsifications of truth.
Actual foolishness, and silliness (a cause of lawful separation).

While men are in (their natural concupiscence), they are like fools, and yet seem to themselves to be wise in the highest degree. From this folly they are by turns let into their Rational, which, with them, is in externals...

Into what blindness, thick darkness, and fatuity they may fall... Into fatuity, because the man still thinks, but from natural things concerning spiritual... thus idiotically, foolishly, and fatuitously.

Then all that he thinks, reasons and speaks about God, Heaven, and the Church, is done in folly, because in darkness... For... when the lumen of the world is separated from the light of higher things, it is fatuous light, in which falsities appear like truths...
Into the fatuous light of Hell.
Becomes sensuous corporeal, which, regarded in itself, is fatuous light.
I saw an ignis fatuus in the air... When the Sun rose it disappeared, as is the case with all fatuous fire.
I thought to myself, What fatuity! TCR 137:7.
It may appear clear from confirmations; but this is from fatuous light...
What is speech then but silly?
They open their eyes to sensuous things, which are in the fatuous light of the bodily senses.
I saw deceptive lights in diverse forms...
Nyctalopia is sight in the dark from a deceptive light.
This cold emanated from the fatuous light of their faith... After sunset travellers see such a fatuous and cold light.
Who does not see the inanity, I do not want to say the folly, in these things?
What madness to speak so! It is folly upon folly.
It is not Known whether the light is fatuous, such as exists in dreams...
A falling star is a meteor composed of fatuous light...
What lunatic does not believe his own folly to be wisdom, and wisdom to be folly: who can by eyesight distinguish the false light of rotten wood from the light of the moon?
Their fatuous state was such...

The prudent and foolish virgins = those who are in faith from love, and those who are in faith without love; in like manner as the prudent and foolish (builders) ().
Profaners of this kind are stupid and foolish in spiritual things, but in worldly ones are cunning and clever.
